verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing claims 70+ HRIS integrations that keep large volumes of data accurate, plus one-click syncing of custom fields, so the core capability exists first-party. The depth is unproven: nothing names Gusto or Rippling, and nothing confirms that new hires and terminations flow automatically into stakeholder or equity records. Missing for 10: named HRIS/payroll connectors (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), documented automatic stakeholder creation for new hires, termination handling affecting vesting or equity records, sync frequency/setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically

citations.quote: Leverage the power of 70+ HRIS integrations to keep large volumes of data accurate.
With Ledgy’s custom fields, you can sync exactly what you need in one click.
